taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-04 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 4201.4 | 5.06 | 5.06
2 | 2238.9 | 4.35 | 9.41
3 | 343.9 | 31.91 | 41.32
4 | 25.0 | 0.99 | 42.31
5 | 10.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QQQ-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-04
Curve type: QQQ
Aquifer depth: 41.32 m to greater than 42.31 m (open-ended)
Recommendation: Target drilling below 41.32 m, where resistivity drops sharply to 25.0 ohm-m and then 10.9 ohm-m, indicating a probable saturated/conductive aquifer zone; plan for continuous sampling through this interval since the 25.0 ohm-m layer is thin (~1 m) and may grade directly into the deeper low-resistivity unit.
